title: A test-run completion overwrites a parked session's preview, so the session card no longer says why its queue is paused
outcome: A test-run completion overwrites a parked session's preview, so the session card no longer says why its queue is paused
acceptance: While a session's queue is paused (queuePaused true) for a Resume-only reason, a later test-run completion or other preview update does not hide the pause reason: the session card or list keeps showing that the queue is paused and why, until the queue resumes.
A test drives a parked session followed by a test-run completion and asserts that the pause reason remains visible.
